name: NEXUS
summary: Network inspection on the desktop: discover devices with multicast DNS, scan TCP ports, look up DNS records and check web servers' redirects, TLS and security headers, on networks you own or may test.

screenshots.alt: The NEXUS page on its Scan section, with a 192.168.1.0/24 target and a table of open ports identified as SSH, HTTP and IPP

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: Send multicast DNS (Bonjour) queries on this network and list the devices that answer
Connect to the hosts and ports you scan: private networks only, unless you allow internet targets and confirm
Look up DNS records with this computer's resolver
Request a web address you enter, through the desktop firewall, and report its redirects, certificate and headers
